body:
Adds `research/contest-precision`: winner-take-all training contests ranked on a noisy holdout. Effort law `V a_n √m/s` (a_2 = a_3 = 1/(2√π) exactly), a precision ceiling beyond which no pure symmetric equilibrium exists, and the optimal holdout size. Pure-Python, 11 tests, white paper, README and portfolio page entry.
